Priya Nair: Quick notebringing SableX-13B (HF -> runtime) int8 onboard. Short smoke shows summarization R1 drop: fp16 42.4 -> int8 40.0. Suspect rotary/headmap mismatch. Anyone take a quick look?
Diego Ramos: I can. Please paste conversion command + quant flags and a deterministic prompt.
Priya Nair: convert cmd:
```
python convert.py --model sablex-13b --out /mnt/models/sablex-int8 --quant int8 --per-channel --block-size 128
```
quant cfg: rotate_scale=auto. prompt: "Summarize: City transit fare policy update." seed=1234
Alex Chen: rotate_scale=auto has bitten us; runtime interprets baseline differently. Try rotate_scale=1.0 and 0.5. Also check tokenizer special token ids (off-by-one).
Maya Patel: ran kv parity for that prompt. Shapes match, but attention phase sign flips on heads 10-13 vs fp16. Looks like head permute during conversion.
Diego Ramos: running compare_logits and per-head norm diffs now. Will upload artifacts.
ci-bot: quant-sanity job queued -> artifacts will land at s3://redwood-dev/sablex/5246809999/
Diego Ramos: quick findings: mean logit delta ~0.22; heads 10-13 dominate. Suggest trying converter headmap override + explicit rotate_scale=0.5.
Alex Chen: I can add a --headmap override to converter and emit head_order.json trace. Also have a runtime probe to permute heads without full reconversion.
Maya Patel: I'll run a 20-item summarization eval after Diego/ Alex artifacts land. If int8 still -2 R1, we'll try hybrid: fp16 for attention proj, int8 elsewhere.
Priya Nair: plan: Diego=reconvert+log diffs; Alex=patch converter and share probe; Maya=evals; we'll decide fallback after results. Thanks team :thumbsup:
